item.title: Help a Partner Place Two Shapes
item.prompt_text: You have a blank card, a red square and a yellow circle. Tell your partner to put the square at the top and the circle under it. Ask them to leave the bottom of the card empty for your name.
item.target_grammar: Imperatives with put and leave. Use at the top and under for position.
item.fluency_objective: Look at the steps first. Say one step at a time and listen for where each shape goes.
item.pronunciation_objective: Stress red square and yellow circle. Leave a short pause before the last step.

cues.text: Place the red square at the top.
Place the yellow circle under the square.
Leave the bottom empty and say why.

item.model_opening: Put the red square at the top of the card, please.
item.model_answer: Put the red square at the top of the card, please. Put the yellow circle under the square. Leave the bottom empty. I want to write my name there.
